## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User and operator impact

Describe visible behavior, configuration, migration, deployment, compatibility, and rollback effects.

## Security and privacy

Describe changes to authentication, authorization, household scoping, sensitive data, networking, integrations, AI, audit behavior, backups, or supply-chain controls. Write `No material change` when none apply.

## Verification

List automated checks and manual scenarios performed.

## Related work

Link related issues, documentation, server changes, and `tallystead-web` changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and failure boundary.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or operations changed.
- [ ] Examples, fixtures, screenshots, and logs contain only fictional or sanitized data.
- [ ] Money, currency, household scoping, provenance, and audit invariants remain explicit.
- [ ] API compatibility and release order are documented when a client contract changed.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime data, backups, private documents, or local environment files are included.
